column3: title card
column5: F: 采购与库存补货。 | M: 买进货、在门店之间调拨，库存不够时再补货。我们来看看 ERP 里普通的一天。
column7: F: Purchasing and stock replenishment. | M: Buying goods, moving them between shops, and topping up when they run low. We will follow one ordinary working day in the ERP.

column3: chapter card 1: buying (order, receive, pay)
column5: F: 先说采购。每个生意都是这个流程：先下订单，再收货，之后付款。 | M: 对应三张单据：采购订单、收货单和供应商发票。这个 ERP 完全照着 iDempiere 来做，所以每一步的样子和行为都和 iDempiere 一样。
column7: F: First, buying. In every business it goes the same way. You order the goods, you receive them, and later you pay the bill. | M: Three documents: a purchase order, a receipt, and a vendor invoice. This ERP follows iDempiere, so every step looks and behaves just as it does there.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT console.offerRows=1 · plugin.installed state=ACTIVE (org.kernel.friendly-ops)
column5: M: 开始之前，先装一个可选的扩展。这个 ERP 靠插件来扩充，插件列表就在这个链接后面：Plugins and Releases。 | F: 我们点一下，就装好一个快捷插件，叫 Friendly operations。你不选它，它就不启用；而且我们先做的所有步骤，没有它也一样能做。
column7: M: Before we start, one optional extra. This ERP grows through plugins, and they are listed behind this link, Plugins and Releases. | F: We install a shortcut plugin, called Friendly operations, with one click. It is off until you choose it, and everything we do first works without it.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT poA Seed Farm, header
column5: F: 现在我们以店铺管理员的身份登录，打开采购订单窗口。采购订单其实就是我们对供应商的一个承诺。 | M: 我们新建一张，选好供应商 Seed Farm 和公司，然后保存表头。
column7: F: Now we log in as the shop's administrator and open the Purchase Order window. A purchase order is simply our promise to a supplier. | M: We start a new one, pick the supplier, Seed Farm, and the company, and save the header.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT poA={"d":"800003","s":"CO"} Mulch, qty 5
column5: M: 接着是明细行，也就是我们要买什么：五袋覆盖物。 | F: 保存明细行，回到订单，按一下完成。完成就是把草稿变成一张真正有约束力的订单，订单状态变成已完成。
column7: M: Then the line: what we are buying. Five bags of mulch. | F: Save the line, go back to the order, and press Complete. Completing is what turns a draft into a real, binding order, and the order shows as Completed.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT infowin.rows=1 · receipt.lines q=3 linked to the order line · count.legacy=13 · mulch.onhandAfterReceipt delta 3
column5: M: 货到了，我们在物料收货单上记录。收货单可以直接从订单把明细行拉过来。 | F: 这个按钮叫 Create Lines From，会打开一个搜索窗口，列出所有还在等着到货的行。我们选订单，勾上这一行。只来了三袋，所以我们输入三。 | M: 运行之后，收货单就有了这一行，并且和订单关联。完成它，货架上就有了三袋。从打开窗口到现在，一共十三步。记住这个数字。
column7: M: The goods arrive, and we record that on a Material Receipt. A receipt can pull its lines straight from the order. | F: This button, Create Lines From, opens a search window with everything still waiting to arrive. We choose the order and tick the line. Only three bags came, so we type a three. | M: Run it, and the receipt has its line, linked to the order. Complete it, and three bags are on the shelf. That took thirteen steps from opening the window. Remember the number.

column3: chapter card 2: the shortcut; second order typed behind it
column5: F: 收货是太常见的工作，所以有个快捷方式。在这张卡片后面，我们已经录入了第二张订单：同一个供应商、同一个商品，也已经完成。 | M: 这个快捷方式是可选的。和我们加的所有东西一样，它放在齿轮菜单里，也就是 iDempiere 存放单据流程的地方。
column7: F: Receiving goods is such a common job that there is a shortcut for it. Behind this card we have typed a second order: same supplier, same product, already completed. | M: The shortcut is optional. Like everything we add, it lives in the gear menu, where iDempiere keeps a document's processes.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT run.FO_Order_Receive ok (receipt CO, 5 bags) · run.FO_Order_Bill ok (invoice CO 13.5) · gear after = Copy Lines only
column5: M: 我们打开齿轮。因为这张订单已经完成、还在等货，菜单就提供了 Receive，也就是收货。 | F: 点一下，收货单就替我们生成、填好并且完成了。五袋全部上架。 | M: 现在齿轮里出现了 Create Bill，它把收货单变成供应商的发票。开过发票之后，菜单就不再提供它了。
column7: M: We open the gear. Because this order is completed and still waiting for its goods, the menu offers Receive. | F: One click, and the receipt is made, filled and completed for us. All five bags are on the shelf. | M: Now the gear offers Create Bill, which turns the receipt into the supplier's invoice. And once it is billed, the menu stops offering it.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT count.legacy=13 · count.FO_Order_Receive=3 (read from this take's click tally)
column4: F: 数出来的，不是估的。
column5: F: 就在这部片子里数出来的：标准做法十三步，用快捷方式三步。 | M: 底层跑的是同一个收货流程，所以不需要学习或信任任何新东西。
column7: F: Counted in this very film. Thirteen steps the standard way, three with the shortcut. | M: Underneath, it is the same receipt process, so nothing new has to be learned or trusted.

column3: chapter card 3: moving stock; in-transit move typed behind it; fixture disclosed
column4: F: 在门店之间调拨库存。
column5: F: 接下来说调拨库存。规模大一点的公司有好几个仓库，货会在仓库之间流动。 | M: 这就是库存调拨。货在卡车上的时候，调拨单被标为在途：货已经离开了一个地方，还没到另一个地方。 | F: 在这张卡片后面，我们录入了一张调拨单：十棵榆树，从总部仓库运到门店中心。这个单据类型是我们为这次演示加在自己这份副本里的。
column7: F: Next, moving stock. Bigger businesses have several warehouses, and goods travel between them. | M: That is an Inventory Move. When the goods are on a truck, the move is marked in transit: they have left one place and not yet arrived at the other. | F: Behind this card we typed one move: ten elm trees from the head office warehouse to Store Central. That document type is one we added to our own copy for this demo.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT move.afterComplete IP + confirm DR · stock.inTransit source 15 target 0
column5: M: 我们按完成，注意它并没有结束。调拨单停在进行中，系统生成了一张确认单，等货到了让门店来填。 | F: 再看库存。什么都没动。十五棵榆树还在总部，门店一棵也没有。这就是在途的意思：货在账上，但不在任何一个货架上。
column7: M: We press Complete, and notice it does not finish. The move stays In Progress, and the system has made a confirmation for the shop to fill in when the goods arrive. | F: Now look at the stock. Nothing has moved. Fifteen elm trees still sit at head office, and none at the store. That is what in transit means: the goods are on the books, but on neither shelf.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT confirm.line.saved target 10 confirmed 8 scrapped 1 difference 2 · after.confirm CO/CO
column5: F: 这是门店的确认单，在调拨确认窗口里。明细行写着发出了十棵。 | M: 门店清点：到了八棵，其中一棵受损，所以报废。我们输入八和一，然后保存。系统自己算出差异：有两棵树没有到。 | F: 然后按完成。确认单和调拨单一起完成。
column7: F: Here is the shop's confirmation, in the Move Confirmation window. The line says ten were sent. | M: The shop counts. Eight arrived, and one of those was damaged, so it is scrapped. We type eight and one, and save. The system works out the difference by itself: two trees never arrived. | F: Then Complete. That finishes the confirmation and the move together.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT inventory.docs (store: scrapped 1; head office: difference 2), both CO
column5: M: 完成时还生成了两张小的库存单据。这一张记录那棵报废的树，在门店中心。 | F: 这一张记录那两棵没有到的树，在总部。没有任何东西是被悄悄删掉的；每一棵不见的树都有一张单据。
column7: M: Completing also wrote two small inventory documents. This one records the single scrapped tree, at Store Central. | F: And this one records the two trees that never arrived, back at head office. Nothing is simply deleted; every missing tree has a document.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT elm.before 15/0 · elm.after 5/7 · differenceDoc 2 · scrappedDoc 1 · elm.conserved=true · books.balanced
column5: F: 那么十棵树去哪儿了？总部从十五棵变成五棵。门店有七棵。两棵记为途中损失，一棵记为报废。 | M: 每一棵都有交代，会计分录也是平衡的。
column7: F: So where did the ten go? Head office went from fifteen to five. The store has seven. Two are written off as lost, and one as scrapped. | M: Every tree is accounted for, and the accounting entries balance.

column3: chapter card 4: topping up (min and max levels)
column5: M: 现在轮到每家店都会问的问题：什么时候再进货？ | F: 每种商品都有最低库存和最高库存。补货报表把它们和货架上的实际数量比较，然后建议订多少。
column7: M: And now the question every shop asks: when do we buy more? | F: Every product has a lowest and a highest stock level. The Replenish Report compares them with what is on the shelf, and proposes how much to order.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT docTypeOptions (Purchase Order offered only after Create is chosen)
column5: F: 我们打开补货报表，选总部仓库。 | M: 然后告诉它要创建什么：采购订单。到这时才出现单据类型这一栏，因为只有到这时才需要它。
column7: F: We open the Replenish Report and choose the head office warehouse. | M: Then we say what to create: purchase orders. Only now does a Document Type box appear, because only now is it needed.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT levels (Elm Tree 5/10/20, Mulch 58/40/75) read from m_replenish + stock
column5: M: 我们按运行。它在工作的时候，来看看它在检查什么。每种商品都有一个最低库存和一个最高库存。 | F: 榆树：货架上只有五棵，低于最低库存十棵，所以需要补货。最高库存是二十，所以报表会要求补十五棵。 | M: 覆盖物是我们前面收的，库存很充足，处在范围之内，所以报表不理它。 | F: 每种商品还有补货方式的规则：手动，低于最低库存时补货，或者一直补到最高库存。 | M: 我们还要选择创建什么：给供应商的采购订单、请购单、从另一个仓库调拨，或者生产订单。今天选采购订单。不管选哪种，报表都只生成草稿。 | F: 真实的商店有成千上万种商品，没有人会去走遍每一个货架。报表还会统计顾客已经预订的数量，以及我们已经向供应商订的数量，这样同一个需求就不会订两次。 | M: 把它想成一位非常有耐心的盘点员。它看货架、看对顾客的承诺、看在途的订单，然后给采购员写一张购物清单。 | F: 采购员始终说了算。草稿在发给供应商之前，可以修改、合并或者丢掉。 | M: 这一切跑下来要一点时间，我们稍等一下。
column7: M: We press Run. While it works, here is what it is checking. Every product has a lowest level and a highest level. | F: Elm trees: only five on the shelf, below the lowest level of ten, so they need ordering. The highest level is twenty, so the report will ask for fifteen. | M: Mulch, which we received earlier, has plenty. It sits inside its range, so the report leaves it alone. | F: Each product also has a rule for how to top up: manually, reorder when below the minimum, or keep it filled to the maximum. | M: And we choose what to create: a purchase order to a supplier, a requisition, a movement from another warehouse, or a production order. Today, purchase orders. Whatever you pick, the report only drafts documents. | F: In a real shop there are thousands of products, and nobody walks every shelf. The report also counts what customers have already reserved, and what we have already ordered from suppliers, so we do not order twice for the same need. | M: Think of it as a very patient stock-taker. It looks at the shelf, at the promises made to customers, and at the orders on the way, and then writes a shopping list for the buyer. | F: The buyer stays in charge. Drafts can be changed, merged or thrown away before anything goes to a supplier. | M: Running all of that takes a little while, so let us give it a moment.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT replenish.result OK #3 · replenish.elm q=15 · replenish.orders 3 DR
column5: F: 好了。报表生成了三张采购订单，榆树在清单上，正好是十五棵，和预期一样。
column7: F: Done. The report made three purchase orders, and elm trees are on the list, fifteen of them, exactly as expected.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT lastPO draft; replenish.orders
column5: M: 这是它创建的其中一张订单，一张草稿。还没有对任何供应商做出承诺；要有人先审核，再按完成。 | F: 有一点要知道。草稿不算已订购，所以如果在完成它们之前再跑一次报表，会建议同样的货。iDempiere 就是这样做的，我们这份副本也一样。
column7: M: Here is one of the orders it created, a draft. Nobody has promised a supplier anything yet; a person still reviews it and presses Complete. | F: One thing to know. Drafts do not count as on order, so running the report again before completing them would propose the same goods again. iDempiere does exactly this, and so does our copy.

column3: §PURCH_FACT parity card (createfrom, matchpo, movement_facts, confirm, inventory, replenish) read from witness logs
column5: F: 这部片子里的一切，都对照真正的 iDempiere 检查过，也就是这个 ERP 所照搬的那个系统。 | M: 卡片显示了有多少个用例一致：收货行、采购订单匹配、库存过账、确认单、实物盘点单据，以及补货报表的逐行对照。 | F: 拍摄的时候，我们还在自己的界面里发现了三处缺口。我们修好了它们，现在它们也有了测试。
column7: F: Everything in this film was checked against the real iDempiere, the ERP this one copies. | M: The card shows how many cases matched: receipt lines, purchase order matches, inventory postings, confirmations, physical count documents, and the Replenish Report, row for row. | F: And while filming, we found three gaps in our own screens. We fixed them, and they are tested now too.

column4: M: 这里每部片子是怎么做的。
column5: M: 这里每一部片子都是这样做的：同一个任务在两个系统上各跑一遍，找出差异，按 iDempiere 的方式修好，再证明一次。然后做下一个任务。 | F: 如果有你希望我们检查的任务，请告诉我们。
column6: M: How every film here is made.
column7: M: This is how every film here is made. Run the same task on both systems, find the gaps, fix them the iDempiere way, and prove it again. Then on to the next task. | F: If there is a task you would like us to check, tell us.
